summary: Join Marvell's team as a Software/Firmware Engineer to develop and test network and cryptographic protocols, conduct research on AI algorithms, and collaborate with engineering teams.
responsibilities: Develop, integrate, and test network and cryptographic protocols using C, C++, and Python
Conduct case studies and develop software prototypes for future products
Collaborate with engineering teams to enhance existing Marvell and open-source software products
required_skills: Proficient in programming languages: C, C++, Python, and scripting languages: Bash, Perl
Strong understanding of Linux OS concepts, data structures, algorithms, computer architecture, and computer networks
Familiarity with ARM/RISCV architecture is desirable
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of Computer Networking fundamentals and tools like ping, tcpdump, iPerf and Wireshark
Good knowledge of programming languages – Data structures and algorithms, Embedded Systems, C/Rust, Scripting lang: bash/perl/e
education_level: Bachelor/Computer Science/Computer Science Engineering (or related fields)
